history.content: hi. um not really sure why im here honestly
Hey, that’s okay. We can just sit with the not-sure part for a moment, or keep it very light if you want.
light is good. i think. its nothing bad its just. a lot. like in a good way maybe? sorry im not making sense
You’re making sense to me, and “a lot” in a good way feels like the main thing here. Maybe we can stay with that without naming it yet.

ok so. i got into a phd program. the one i didnt think id get. found out yesterday and i still havent really told anyone properly. it doesnt feel real and its in a different city and everything is gonna change and i keep grinning at my phone like an idiot
That sounds like a mix of excitement and something almost unreal, with the change in the background too.

yeah the unreal part. like i worked so long for this and now its here and i dont know what im supposed to feel. happy obviously but theres this whole life i cant picture yet. new place new people. i dont even know where ill live. and im excited but my stomach does a thing when i think about september
The excited part is clear, and there’s also some unease around September, especially when the future feels blank. Where does that “stomach does a thing” feel like, if you want to stay with it?

kind of like the top of a rollercoaster i guess. that drop feeling. but its not dread its more like. anticipation? both at once. honestly saying it out loud helps. its mostly good. i think i just needed to admit im allowed to be excited even if i cant see whats coming

That feels like relief sitting next to excitement, and they seem to be arriving together rather than separately. If you want, we can leave it there, or stay with what that “drop” feeling is making room for.
yeah. lets leave it there. i feel a bit lighter. thank you for letting me just say it without making it a big thing. ok im gonna go tell my mom now i think
That sounds like a good place to end, and I’m glad it got a little lighter. Go tell your mom.
